# Pull request

## What changed

What was going wrong for somebody using this, and how you went about fixing it.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests that would have caught this, added or updated
- [ ] `scripts/gate.sh` run locally and passing
- [ ] Changelog updated, if this changes anything a user would notice
- [ ] Only invented CV, posting, and contact details anywhere in the diff
- [ ] Nothing in the tests reaches a live provider, keyring, or job board
- [ ] Substantial AI assistance disclosed here, and its output reviewed

## Remaining limits

Any limit or risk this change leaves in place, or "none".
